cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Join Me
cards.instruction: Recruit someone into a secret plan.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We need twenty minutes to hide Mum's cake. Ask about her pastry; 'come here, it's a surprise' is not a distraction.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I only said that last year.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And she found the cake. This time, ask her to show you how she crimps the edge.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She'll make me bake a whole pie.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Ask about one edge. I'll give you a strip of pastry; we need a demonstration, not a second birthday meal.

reason: Recruit B with a specific cover and correct both the earlier obvious announcement and the overly broad baking request, preserving the secret cake objective.
